Record Class SimulationDelta

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.SimulationDelta
Record Components:
tick - Current simulation tick
individualUpdates - Changed individuals
cellUpdates - Changed cells
newIndividualIds - Newly spawned individuals
removedIndividualIds - Dead/removed individuals
public record SimulationDelta(long tick, List<SimulationDelta.IndividualUpdate> individualUpdates, List<SimulationDelta.CellUpdate> cellUpdates, List<String> newIndividualIds, List<String> removedIndividualIds) extends Record
Represents a delta (incremental update) in simulation state. Used for efficient network transmission - only changed data is sent.
